name: Control Chart (Short-Run Z-MR)
description: Standardised I-MR across parts with different targets
whenToUse: Control-chart short production runs that mix parts with different targets: each value is standardised within its part and plotted on one Z-MR chart.
groupsHint: Identifies the part for each measurement. Mean and σ̂ are computed separately per part.
warningSkipped: {count} value(s) could not be standardised (part has too few points for σ̂ — shown as z=0).

invariants.chartKeys: Settings exist only for the Z chart and the MR chart.
